principles: repair mutation must be bounded and auditable
terminal story cleanup should restore user-visible health reports
active worktrees and unrelated branches are protected objects
unremovable filesystem residue should be quarantined rather than retried forever
drivers: doctor/story_list currently surface terminal residue after DONE/DISCARDED
git worktree registry can contain stale admin dirs or 0000000 entries
macOS/iCloud directories may hang ordinary recursive deletion
user needs repeatable repair without manual git surgery

options.name: A: repair at mutation boundaries plus quarantine marker
pros: doctor --repair and story_discard own cleanup responsibility
unremovable residue stops causing repeated false alarms
cons: quarantine marker leaves a physical directory visible on disk when OS deletion is broken

options.name: B: make story_list auto-clean terminal residue
pros: users see cleanup while listing stories
cons: turns read-only query into a mutation and risks repeating the original read-side-effect class of bugs

options.name: C: only document manual git/rm commands
cons: does not solve repair hanging or registry corruption for normal users

chosen: A: repair at mutation boundaries plus quarantine marker
rationale: 选择 A，因为这把 mutation 留在 doctor/story_discard 这类显式清理命令里，同时让 story_list 保持查询语义；对 OS 层面无法删除的目录用 marker 留痕，避免 repair 卡死或持续误报。

preMortem.scenario: doctor --repair 误删 active story worktree
preMortem.trigger: cleanup target 收集没有区分 terminal story 和 active story
preMortem.consequence: 用户正在开发的 worktree 丢失
preMortem.mitigation: 只清理 terminalRegistered/orphans/terminalDirs，并用 smoke 覆盖 active worktree 保留

preMortem.scenario: rm -rf 遇到 iCloud/dataless 目录长时间卡死
preMortem.trigger: 递归删除没有 timeout 或 fallback 又进入阻塞 API
preMortem.consequence: doctor --repair 一直无输出，用户以为 Koala 死锁
preMortem.mitigation: 使用 execFileSync rm -rf timeout，失败后写 .koala-repair-ignore 并继续报告

preMortem.scenario: stale .git/worktrees admin 目录让 git worktree list 继续显示 0000000
preMortem.trigger: git worktree prune 无法处理 malformed/missing-path metadata
preMortem.mitigation: 按 branch/gitdir/path 匹配并删除 stale admin dir，然后重扫验证

preMortem.scenario: quarantine marker 掩盖真正仍应修复的 Koala residue
preMortem.trigger: 任何 repair 失败都被静默 ignore
preMortem.consequence: 用户看不到需要人工处理的失败原因
preMortem.mitigation: doctor repair 输出 repairFailed，marker 内记录 reason/timestamp，且只跳过后续 scan 报警
